painPoints.title: SS7 Network Vulnerability & Legacy Protocol Security
painPoints.description: Odido's existing SS7 infrastructure faces increasing security threats from telecom fraud and unauthorized access. Current NewNet Communications SS7 implementation lacks advanced threat detection and real-time anomaly detection capabilities for signaling attacks, requiring manual intervention and reactive remediation.

painPoints.title: IMS Network Interoperability & Roaming Complexity
painPoints.description: Odido experiences integration challenges between legacy IMS core and third-party carrier roaming partners. NewNet Communications IMS signaling software struggles with non-standard Diameter implementations from international partners, causing call failures and revenue leakage in roaming scenarios.

painPoints.title: SMS Interworking & A2P Gateway Bottlenecks
painPoints.description: Current NewNet Communications signaling stack has limited SMS A2P (Application-to-Person) throughput for commercial messaging partners. Bottlenecks in SIP/SMPP interworking create message delivery delays and partner SLA violations during peak traffic periods.

opportunities.title: Upgrade to NewNet 5G Signaling & Diameter Enhancement
opportunities.description: Expand NewNet Communications next-gen signaling software to support advanced 5G control plane protocols (3GPP TS 29.xxx), including enhanced Diameter routing and policy enforcement. Enable Odido to monetize premium 5G services (network slicing, edge computing) across enterprise and mobile customer segments.

opportunities.title: NewNet RCS & Rich Communications Platform Implementation
opportunities.description: Deploy NewNet Communications IMS/SIP-based RCS (Rich Communications Services) platform to replace aging SMS for Odido's B2B messaging and consumer communications. Unlock new revenue streams via enterprise messaging APIs, brand messaging, and verified SMS compliance. Includes upgrade from current SS7/LTE baseline.
